user.title: Follow a media player
user.description: Select a player with movie title and accurate playback position. Exact title/year matches only; ambiguous results need manual selection. Generic player metadata cannot identify editions. No account required.

init.title: Playback timing
init.description: Positive offset delays windows for pre-roll: movie position = player position − offset. Non-1× speed is unsupported.

error.invalid_input: Enter a whole-second offset between −3600 and 3600.
